Add source_id to list that source's metrics (name, unit, years, aggregation) and its filterable and sortable fields; search to match metrics across the pack by name, description, or keyword; or metr

Disaster event rows include stable event_id values for get_event drill-down. A parent administrative loc_id selects matching descendant rows at the pac

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pack" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Inspect one exact data pack ID for its metrics, time coverage, and query metadata before get_data." → after: "Narrow one data pack before get_data. With only pack_id, lists the pack's sources and their coverage. Add source_id to list that source's metrics (name, unit, years, aggregation) and its filterable and sortable fields; search to match metrics across the pack by name, description, or keyword; or metr"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
